run_sweep_inference_benchmark: run an inference benchmark sweep across different GPU configurations using a config YAML file
run_benchmark_with_natoms: run a benchmark sweep with fixed atom counts across multiple GPU counts using the CLI
run_benchmark_with_natoms_per_gpu: run a benchmark sweep with per-GPU atom counts that scale with GPU count using the CLI
calculate_node_gpu_distribution: calculate the number of nodes and GPUs per node for a given total GPU count
generate_scaling_plots: generate weak and strong scaling plots from aggregated benchmark results for each model
